verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own quickstart docs say SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS and other frameworks are managed in one place, which matches the story's core requirement. Framework-health APIs back up the multi-framework model, but the evidence is mostly a single summary claim rather than detailed per-framework documentation. Missing for 10: framework-specific docs for HIPAA and PCI DSS control mappings, documented cross-framework control reuse, and independent or hands-on confirmation of multi-framework use.

support.subject: As an operations lead, frameworks beyond SOC 2 and ISO — HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS — are supported from the same platform so new customer requirements don't mean a new tool

citations.quote: One platform, multiple frameworks: Manage SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and others in one place.
Sprinto is a security compliance automation platform designed to help cloud-hosted companies meet and maintain compliance across standards like SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and more.
